subject: Locking a concise 30‑min preview — two windows & SME nominations

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-discovery recap & proposed 30‑min preview windows

Hi Lena / Jason —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a practical next step to keep momentum:

- Key takeaways: Spectra is focused on improving free‑text triage latency and reducing embedding costs for large historical records. You mentioned an initial pilot covering the oncology cohort and a longer term interest in model quantization.
- Success criteria for the preview: show realistic latency at 2k token seals, demonstrate embedding vector quality on a small sample, and outline a pilot mutual action plan (MAP).

Next step: a short 30‑minute product preview (concise walkthrough + Q&A). Two scheduling windows that work on our side — pick one that aligns with your SMEs and time zone:

Option A — Tue, 08 Dec 2026, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
Option B — Thu, 10 Dec 2026, 02:00–02:30 PM PT

If neither is feasible, we can offer a single backup slot (Mon, 14 Dec, 11:00 AM PT).

Please confirm which slot you prefer and who from your side will attend (engineering + security contacts if available). That will help me bring the right Redwood teammates: Neha (security & architecture) and Karthik (infrastructure/engineer) are on standby.

Proposed agenda (30m):
- 0–5: Quick context recap and success criteria
- 5–18: Live preview (latency, embeddings, routing/cost controls)
- 18–28: Q&A focused on integration/resourcing
- 28–30: Immediate next steps / MAP items

I attached a short mutual action plan draft and our security brief for your review.

[Attachment: MAP-draft.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: security-brief.pdf (PDF)]

Thanks — happy to adapt the agenda if you'd prefer more infra depth.

Best,
Hiro Tanaka
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192
